entities.summary: Bernadette Anne MacDougall, better known by her pen name B. A. Paris, is a British writer of fiction, mainly in the psychological thriller subgenre. Her debut novel, Behind Closed Doors (2016), was a New York Times and Sunday Times bestseller. It has been translated into 40 languages and sold over 3.5 million copies worldwide.
